caption: The drawing consists of three distinct objects, arranged horizontally on a plain, slightly yellowed background. At the top, there is a rectangular form with slightly tapered sides, outlined in black, and marked at the center with an ornate script monogram "A E" embellished with decorative swirls. Below this, the second object is a pair of elongated tongs, also outlined in black, with rounded spoon-like tips at both ends and a smooth curvature forming the handle. Beneath the tongs, the third object is a utensil with a scalloped or fluted circular end, a narrow neck, and a broader handle that appears faceted. The handle is labeled with the inscription "SWANE-MAIK" in uppercase letters. The objects are rendered in fine linework, and the overall drawing is monochromatic, using only black ink on a cream background. The artist's signature "WALT O.N.J.K." is located in the bottom left corner of the drawing.
title: Silver Sugar Tongs
